_comment: Numen STT (voice-input) providers. backend='whisper-http' means OpenAI-compatible POST {base}/v1/audio/transcriptions (multipart file+model), batch: nothing is sent until you release the mic. backend='doubao' is Volcengine's realtime WebSocket ASR: audio streams while you speak and partial text lands in the input box. Its key field takes the single API Key from the new console (sent as X-Api-Key); old-console credentials still work if written as 'appid:access_token'. Its 'model' entries are resource ids (model generation + billing tier: seedasr = streaming ASR 2.0, bigasr = 1.0), because the model name is always 'bigmodel'. Per provider: base URL + known model ids. Model lists refreshed from each provider's docs (2026-07); best-effort, may drift. USER-EDITABLE: this is copied to config/numen/stt.json on first run; edit that file to add your own providers/models or override URLs. Built-in providers are the base and your file overrides them by id, so providers added in later versions still show up. The settings 'custom' model escape hatch also accepts any id.
